title: refactor(i18n)!: retire the dead Packaged automation flows and Manage Objects keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCUuypZTBgQpogKyBc9s5Lq)_

Fixes #28789

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:内置语言包 `@object-ui/i18n` 的十种语言里,删掉 28 个已无任何界面读取的文案键:已下线的「打包自动化」流程页(流程列表与克隆对话框)用到的 25 个,和首页已移除的「管理对象」入口用到的 3 个。另把 service-automation 里一条仍写着旧页面引用 `automation:packaged` 的注释改为现在的 `automation:packaged-actions`。
- **为什么改**:这两个界面已在 #28785 与 #28818 中下线,但文案还留在语言包里,每次翻译与改语言包的 PR 都要白白维护它们。
- **风险与回滚**:运行时零变化:没有任何 `t()` 调用读这些键,「打包动作」页仍在用的键全部保留。破坏性只在 TypeScript 类型上:导出的 `TranslationKeys` 少了这 28 个键,按类型引用它们的代码会编译报错;用 `t('...')` 字符串调用的不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 的 `packagedAutomation` 块(删除后剩下的就是「打包动作」页读的键);`.changeset/28789-i18n-retire-packaged-flows-keys.md` 的迁移表;`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/dead-key-batch-retired-4730.test.ts` 删掉的两行。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下运行 `node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs | grep -cE 'packagedAutomation\.|manageObjects|systemNav\.objectManager'`,预期输出 0(main 上是 28)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(本 PR 是 narrowing,落地前需总监的 contract-tier 复核,由席位转交)。

## What changes

- **28 keys leave all ten packs** (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh) of `@object-ui/i18n`. They are exactly the keys `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` names under the card's three prefixes at `origin/main` `39951d2a`:
  - `packagedAutomation.*` (25): the retired flows list (`title`, `subtitle`, `flowsHeading`, `colFlow`, `colActions`, `toggleLabel`, `notRunning`, `notRunningDeploymentPolicy`, `reasonDetails`, `emptyTitle`, `emptyBody`, `loadFailed`) and its clone dialog (`clone`, `cloneTitle`, `cloneBody`, `cloneName`, `cloneLabel`, `cloneCopyLabel`, `cloneConfirm`, `cloneCreated`, `cloneSwitchSourceOff`, `cloneSourceOff`, `cloneOpen`, `cloneFailed`, `cloneFailedHttp`).
  - `home.quickActions.manageObjects`, `home.quickActions.manageObjectsDesc` and `layout.systemNav.objectManager`: Home's retired Manage Objects entry.
- **The keys Setup's Packaged actions page reads stay**: `refresh`, `actionsHeading`, `colActivation`, `on`, `off`, `cancel`, `toggleFailed`, `toggleFailedHttp` and the `actions*` / `switched*` / `actionOff*` family. The `en` and `zh` group comments now describe the surviving actions page instead of the retired flows half.
- **Two test pins follow** (surface amendment 6575664582): `dead-key-batch-retired-4730.test.ts` drops `home.quickActions.manageObjects` and `layout.systemNav.objectManager` from its SURVIVING list, and `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` moves its census from 104 to 103 matched pairs, because `cloneCreated`'s German value carried one, with a history line in both places.
- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credentials-ui.ts`**: the docblock compared the connector-credentials entry to Setup's packaged-automation entry and its `automation:packaged` ref, which no longer exists. It now names the packaged-actions entry and `automation:packaged-actions`. Comment only.
- **Changeset** `@object-ui/i18n` patch, BREAKING, with the removed-key table (no replacement for any key) and ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys)`.

**Contract review owed:** this is a `(narrowing)` of a published type surface. It owes a CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review, which the seat routes to the director. It was not self-reviewed.

## Tests

- `check-i18n-dead-keys`: 345 candidates (52 CONFIRMED / 293 NEEDS-REVIEW) on main, 317 (31 / 286) after. That is exactly 28 fewer (21 / 7), and none remain under the three prefixes.
- Reverse check on the BUILT types: a probe in `@object-ui/app-shell` importing `TranslationKeys` from `@object-ui/i18n` (rebuilt `dist`) got TS2339 on `packagedAutomation.cloneCreated` and `home.quickActions.manageObjects`. `packagedAutomation.actionsHeading` compiled. The probe was deleted, and the tree was clean after.
- `vitest run packages/i18n/` (95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped), including `all-locales-key-parity`, the two amended pins and `de-quote-pairing-3876`.

## Acceptance notes

- Seven of the 28 are NEEDS-REVIEW, not CONFIRMED. Their only footprints outside the packs were `ui/packages/{app-shell,i18n}/CHANGELOG.md` history (`cloneCopyLabel`, `cloneSwitchSourceOff`, `notRunning`, `reasonDetails`), two history comments in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` (`cloneCreated`), and the SURVIVING rows of the 4730 pin (`manageObjects`, `objectManager`). A grep of each full key and each bare leaf over `ui/`, `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/` and `content/` found no reader. The two `notRunning` hits are `engine.studio.auto.notRunning`, a different key. The seat chose to retire all 28 in this one narrowing (option A).
- The non-`en`/`zh` group comments are translator terminology notes, and they are left as they were.

## Verification

Head `ac6202e4` merges `origin/main` `153869d7`. Neither main merge conflicted. The incoming commits add and change other keys in the packs. None of them touches the removed keys or a reader of them (the dead-keys count under the three prefixes is still 0 at the head).

<details><summary>Type-checks and i18n checks (head ac6202e4)</summary>

- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/i18n --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/console`: 73/73 tasks successful (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). It was also green at `ccd69fb7` and `4672ff47`.
- `vitest run packages/i18n/`: 95/95 files, 1443 passed / 13 skipped.
- `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` exit 0, `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` exit 0, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0, `pnpm check:adr-0087-registration` exit 0 (1 declared-breaking changeset, runtime-interface-only verified).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep and dogfood battery</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `ccd69fb7`: 63 families. All 63 were run with exit 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4900 tests) and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 before the full build and 0 after it. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, closure built) on `4672ff47`: Test Files 391 passed, 3 skipped (394), Tests 3223 passed, 28 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0. The final head `ac6202e4` only adds a merge of main that does not touch this diff.

</details>
